To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have proposed a novel method for creating evolving user profiles automatically, based on a trie-based representation of the user behavior.

(i) we have developed an evolving user profiling approach, which is based on a trie data structure, and (ii) we have developed a novel method to compute the potential of a user profile to become a cluster centroid.
the proposed method is a novel, efficient and accurate way of creating evolving user behavior profiles automatically.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of automatically recognizing the user behavior in a computer environment.
the development of a new approach for modeling the behavior of computer users in order to assist them in their tasks, to predict their behavior or to detect masqueraders.
the problem of automatically creating and evolving the user behavior profile.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our approach outperforms the other approaches on all the datasets used in this work.
the proposed approach is able to detect the user behavior and to recognize it in a real time.
the proposed approach can be applied to any problem of modeling user behavior where it can be expressed as a sequence of events/actions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a novel approach for creating evolving user behavior profiles automatically.
the proposed method is capable of learning and recognizing the behavior profile of the user in an online manner.
it is the first work to propose the use of a dynamic/evolving classifier for the problem of user modeling and behavior recognition.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed approach is able to learn and recognize user behavior profiles in real-time, and to adapt itself when the user behavior changes.
we can create automatically a behavior profile for any user, even if she/he is not a regular user of the system, and also we can update this profile automatically as time evolves.
the proposed method is very efficient and effective for the creation of evolving user behavior profiles.
